GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 383.6 (26 Apr 52) ESS
(SCAPIN-2204)
APO 500
26 April 1952
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
SUBJECT : Reversal of Swiss Franc Transactions.
1. The Japanese Government will, before 2200 hours, 28 April 1952, issue payment orders in favor of Her Britannic Majesty's Minister at Berne, Switzerland, for two sums of Swiss francs in amounts of 863,368.12 and 3,478,600.00 representing certain remittances from the United Kingdom to Japan via Switzerland for relief of British prisoners-of-war and civilian internees in Japanese hands.
2. As soon as payment of these sums has been made to Her Majesty's Government, the British Embassy in Japan will arrange for transfer to the Japanese Government of the yen counterpart of the Swiss francs in the amounts indicated in paragraph 1 above.
3. The Japanese Government is advised that Her Britannic Majesty's Government has given assurance that it will not regard the transaction specified in paragraph 1 above as creating a precedent and will not make any other similar claims in respect of Japanese assets in Switzerland or any other neutral country.
4. This directive is not to be construed as establishing a precedent in matters concerning reversal of remittance transactions.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
C.C.B. WARDEN
Colonel, AGC
Adjutant General
